Run the checks
nodes.command:
# Runs the checks of this repo as CI does, and the tests of each workspace the branch changed.
# The data names the outcome: a failed check is work for the agent, not a broken step.
set -e
bun install
set +e
failed=""
report=""
check() {
	name="$1"
	shift
	echo "== $name"
	if out=$("$@" 2>&1); then
		echo "passed"
	else
		tail=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 60)
		printf '%s\n' "$tail"
		failed="$failed $name"
		report=$(printf '%s\n\n## %s\n%s' "$report" "$name" "$tail")
	fi
}
check biome bunx biome ci .
check layers bun scripts/check-layers.ts
check verticals bun scripts/check-verticals.ts
check types env VITE_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000 bunx turbo check-types
for dir in $(git diff --name-only "{{branch.sha}}" HEAD | awk -F/ '/^(apps|packages)\// { print $1 "/" $2 }' | sort -u); do
	if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && grep -q '"test"' "$dir/package.json"; then
		check "tests:$dir" sh -c "cd '$dir' && bun test --timeout 60000"
	fi
done
FAILED="$failed" REPORT="$report" bun -e '
const failed = (process.env.FAILED ?? "").trim();
console.log(JSON.stringify({
	outcome: failed === "" ? "pass" : "fail",
	failed: failed === "" ? [] : failed.split(" "),
	report: (process.env.REPORT ?? "").trim(),
}));
' > "$NS_OUTPUT"

exits.name: fail
exits.description: A check fails: the data says which.
